name: tickets
description: Support tickets triaged from precedent: record each ticket with how it was handled, and ask which handling fits a new one

record.description: Record a ticket and, when known, how it was handled (its outcome)

query.description: What the precedents say about a ticket: the leading outcome, its confidence, and the precedents it stands on

facts.description: The closest precedents, best first, each cut to what the caller may see

probabilities.description: P(outcome | ticket) over the nearest precedents

decide.description: Decide a ticket's handling from precedent; with no precedent close enough, asks for the outcome and records it

start.description: How many precedents the model holds
